column1: # Hand-kept judgements for tools/inventory.py, joined to a player by its file name (any directory) or its path under ~/.config/deliplayer. Seeded from the 2026-11-15 survey.

column2: MED / OctaMED v1 "MED\x04" modules that src/replay/med rejects as unknown format (index shows 8-channel / flag-byte variants: header bytes 4d454404 c0.. / e0..)
column9: Of 302 MED\x04 files in the header index 293 play by default, 9 only through the 68k OctaMED player (e.g. "man machine.med", "MED.eight channel symphonium", "MED.pac_xing8"). A variant gap in an existing open replayer, not a missing format. Needs black-box comparison against the 68k player (Eagleplayers/OctaMED, DeliPlayers/PlayerStore/OctaMED).

column2: Jochen Hippel code-type modules (68k code header 60xx 60xx 48e7fffe) that src/replay/hippel rejects
column9: Index: 85 code-type files, 75 play by default, 10 only via the 68k Hippel player (cybernoid 2.hip, crazy comets.hip, loading2.hip, prince.hip, astaroth.hip, the seven gates of jambala (ingame).hip, hip.boot_loader, and 3 xz-wrapped: RSI, Quartex - Intro, Rings Of Medusa). Header bytes look the same as the ones that play, so likely a data-layout variant. 3 refcmp rows exist for the format already.

column2: Rob Hubbard modules that start with 68k BRA code ("rh." / ".rh" compiled single-file form)
column9: One index file (sanxion-demo.rh, 90782 bytes, header 600000d6 60000026) plays only through the 68k player; the other 6 plays by default. 2 further rh.ins files are companion-only and played by neither build.

9 PSID files in the index (30 *.sid names, the rest are other formats). Plays only with --features sid (src/sid, port of libsidplayfp/reSIDfp, GPL-2.0-only), which is not default. Decision is licence, not spec: either allow the feature or write a clean-room SID player (L).

column2: ZX Spectrum AY container types ST11 and STRC (Sound Tracker data)
column9: src/replay/ay.rs plays ZXAYEMUL and ZXAYAMAD; ST11 and STRC are left alone by detect. Local sample: dl-modules/ay-types/strc/mega mix 1.strc plus ST11 format notes. Real-world module count is small.

Not a gap. UADE ships only SUN-Tronic (prefix sun) and Tronic, and both are covered by open replayers (refcmp rows 1421-1428 and 1514-1521). This Eagleplayer refused all 15 .sun files tried. The 3 Tronic/Suntronic DeliTracker custom modules in dl-modules/SUNtronic-Custom-candidates/ play in the default build through the custom-module host, within 0.3-1.1 dB of UADE over 20 s (2026-11-15, fixround/suncus/).

column2: GlueMaster 2.1 ripped from His Master's Noise Reset (format unidentified)
column9: Refused GlueMon files and all 16 Glue Master tunes of His Master's Noise (Modland "His Master's Noise/Glue Master/", in dl-modules/gluemaster-hmn/, 2026-11-15): those are "M&K!" ProTracker modules that the built-in ProTracker plays. Format still unidentified; the HMN music disk images (M&K-hismastersNoise-A/B.dms) are the next lead.

Refused all 8 EarAche corpus files and the EASO-headed skydance.ea (Modland EarAche/_unknown/, dl-modules/ea-skydance/; the 68k EarAche and the open EarAche both play it), so "Grouleff = EAS0" does not hold; no file of its own format found.

column2: Wizard of Sound 1.3 (needs EP-WOS.cfg and instruments)
column9: No module found anywhere in the index (0 matches).

Two player files (DeliPlayers/PlayerStore/GMOD, Eagleplayers/GMOD). 0 files with that name; one index file carries a GMOD magic only by coincidence in its name. Also needed by BFB Master's GMOD replayer.
0 files. dl-modules/xmodule-src exists (a different, unrelated XMODULE source tree; not verified).

column2: NES music (.nsa rips of the A/NES emulator)
column9: 3 files made 2026-11-16 in dl-modules/nesa/ (SOURCES.md): A/NES PRO 1.19 (aminet misc/emu/anespro.lha) run in FS-UAE+AROS (rig fixround/anes/rig/), NESA3 rips of public-domain / permissive homebrew ROMs by Shiru (FamiTone2 demo: Danger Streets, After the Rain; cc65 example8, same tune as Danger Streets). NESA_note (DeliPlayers/PlayerStore) plays all three. NESA keeps no DPCM samples. Next: clean-room spec from black-box runs; src/replay/nsf_*.rs has a NES APU.

column2: BFB music disk BMOD / GMOD replayers (bfbplaymaster.library)
column9: SUPPORTED IN THE 68K BUILD only (host-68k; relabelled 2026-11-16, no open replayer planned; no BMOD/GMOD samples). The host already runs it (README, BFB Master): no check, so only with --player BFB; it plays through bfbplaymaster.library and libs/replayers/bfbplay*.library loaded from disk (Oktalyzer, ProTracker M.K., DigiBooster, AHX 1 play). The master library refuses a file without a signature in its first long / word 12 ("InitPlayer of BFB failed"): that is why the 13 P61 modules of BFB Team's Mystify (aminet demo/sound/Mystify.lha, dl-modules/bfb-mystify/, no "P61A" tag; the built-in ProTracker plays them) are refused, by the original too. Library package: aminet mus/play/BFBPlayMasterU.lha + BFBPlayMasterD.lha (dl-modules/bfbplaymaster/, freeware-for-freeware, reference only). Its own BMOD format has no module anywhere; GMOD see GMOD. The 2 custom modules the inventory once listed as taken by it were played by the custom-module host.

column2: whatever the system datatypes decode beyond 8SVX, AIFF, WAV (IFF 16SV, etc.)
column9: IFF 16SV (5 files in fixround/unverified/mods/16sv) fail in the default build; the 68k DataType players also crash in the engine, so neither build plays them. Not 68k-only.
